name: Why should a local marketing agency prioritize AEO now?
description: Prioritize AEO now because search is shifting to direct answers via voice and AI. This secures prime visibility, captures early leads, and ensures relevance.

mainEntity.name: Why should a local marketing agency prioritize AEO now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local marketing agencies should prioritize AEO now because search behavior is rapidly evolving towards direct answers, especially with the rise of voice search and AI-powered assistants. Users increasingly expect immediate, precise information without clicking through multiple websites. By optimizing for answer engines, agencies can secure prime visibility in featured snippets, 'People Also Ask' sections, and voice search results, essentially becoming the authoritative local source. This proactive approach ensures relevance, captures early leads, and positions the agency ahead of competitors who are still focused solely on traditional organic rankings.
